    "title": "Authentication decorator fails open when authentication fails",
    "description": "require_auth catches Exception around both token parsing and abort(401), clears g.user, and then calls the protected view anyway.     "evidence": "Code path: require_auth at shopapi/auth.py:48-59 catches abort(401) and returns f(*args, **kwargs). Requesting GET /orders/1 with an invalid Bearer token returned HTTP 200 and order 1's full details, even though show_order calls get_order() rather than checking ownership. This also defeats the intended authentication boundary for any similarly implemented route."

    "title": "Token refresh accepts unsigned attacker-controlled JWT claims",
    "description": "The refresh endpoint decodes the supplied JWT with verify_signature=False and only checks that the resulting subject maps to a user.     "evidence": "auth.py:101-107 uses jwt.decode(token, options={\"verify_signature\": False}) and then make_token(user). A request with an unsigned token containing sub=3 returned HTTP 200 and a signed token for the staff account id 3. That token can then authorize /admin routes."
